scientific_integrity: Finite exact arithmetic checks supplement, but do not replace, the infinite symbolic proof. Prior work on the same asymptotic is expressly credited.
scientific_limitations: The exact expansion and eventual floor equality follow from a 2025 generalized-Lucas asymptotic; the distinct all-index uniform 0<R_n-T_n<1/10 bound is established here. No optimal error claim; no independent validation.
title: An all-index floor formula and a uniform residual bound for reciprocal fourth powers of Pell numbers
